allow: Bash(powershell -Command "$c = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:4000/ -UseBasicParsing\).Content; Write-Host \(''agent-hero: '' + $c.Contains\(''agent-hero''\)\); Write-Host \(''contact-card-section: '' + $c.Contains\(''contact-card-section''\)\); Write-Host \(''services-overview: '' + $c.Contains\(''services-overview''\)\); Write-Host \(''quote-form-section: '' + $c.Contains\(''quote-form-section''\)\)")

Bash(powershell -File - <<'PS1'
$c = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:4000/ -UseBasicParsing\).Content

Write-Host "contact-card-section: $\($c.Contains\('contact-card-section'\)\)"
